title: Emotion Network Analysis During COVID-19 Quarantine - A Longitudinal Study
limitations: - Did not perform group classification based on gender, work status, presence of more people at home, history of mental health problems, and personality characteristics; - Generalizability of findings limited due to high attrition; - Use of POMS may have influenced clustering in networks; - Potential replicability problems with network analysis methods.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration or availability of code/data. The dataset is not readily available for public use. The authors state that data should be requested via email.
